text:
Maya: Hammie (the dwarf hamster) is staging a one-ham protest and will not leave the sunbeam. photo: https://images.internal/hammie_sunbeam1.jpg
Drew: omg he is a toasted marshmallow :heart_eyes:
Kofi: This is now the official team meeting location until further notice :joy:
Nina: We require a close-up. Please prioritize.
Maya: dropping more — big yawns and the tiniest paw stretch. gif: https://images.internal/hammie_stretch.gif
Drew: I will reschedule my 3pm to accommodate Hammie time.
Kofi: can we set a recurring 'pet of the week' calendar event?
Maya: convinced him to move with a sunflower seed. victory. picture: https://images.internal/hammie_seed2.jpg
ops-bot: Reminder: bring-your-pet sticker sheet has arrived at HQ reception :tada:
Nina: also, Hammie's loafing intensity = 11/10 :ok_hand:
Drew: official sticker candidate: Hammie in sunbeam.
Maya: scheduling a Hammie break for anyone who needs a micro boost — 5 mins, right now. :sun_with_face:
Kofi: joining. :coffee: :hamster:
